text: {"status":"complete","candidates":[{"dialogueCueIds":["c1","c2","c3","c4"],"contextCueIds":[],"utterances":[{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c1","start":0,"end":34}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c2","start":0,"end":40}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c3","start":0,"end":33}]},{"sourceSpans":[{"cueId":"c4","start":0,"end":4}]}],"learningValue":"展示詢問原因、說明即將發生卻被中斷的動作（aller 的未完成過去時＋不定式），以及禮貌請求對方稍候的實用日常對話。","opportunities":[{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c2"],"description":"「aller 的未完成過去時（j'allais）＋動詞原形」搭配「quand ＋ 複合過去時」，用來表達「正準備做某事時被突發事件打斷」。"},{"category":"usage","sourceCueIds":["c3"],"description":"動詞「patienter」在日常與服務場合中用來禮貌表示「請稍候」，比單純用「attendre」更具客氣語氣。"},{"category":"grammar","sourceCueIds":["c1","c3"],"description":"比較疑問句的不同形式：主謂倒裝的「Pourquoi êtes-vous...」與語調上揚陳述句型的「Vous pouvez patienter...？」。"}]}]}
